stem: In an exponential model, the value of \(y\) decreases by \(10\%\) for each increase of 1 in \(x\). The model gives \(y = 500\) when \(x = 0\). What is the value of \(y\) when \(x = 3\)?
solution: A decrease of \(10\%\) each step means multiplying by \(0.9\) each step: \(y = 500(0.9)^{x}\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
f = 500 * Rational(9, 10)**x
r = f.subs(x, 3)
assert r == Rational(729, 2)
assert all(Rational(s) == r for s in spr_answers)
